title: New class: the Songweaver
changes: The Songweaver, a lute-playing minstrel from Oakvale, joins the Wizard, Vampire and Summoner. Songs heal and lift your party, discord hurts your foes, and a good tune carries you alone.
Songweaver skills are built on music: learn new keys, switch between them mid-fight, and play three notes in the right order to ring out a chord.
Monsters hear differently. Some are deaf to a song, some flinch at it, and glassy ones can ring until they shatter. Watch the ear icon above them.
Sound bounces off stone and walls and rings in foes until it bursts. Busking a bright tune in Oakvale is welcome; a dark one is not.
